note: FABRICATED governance register: candidate parent (1000/3100) cost lines screened for shareholder/stewardship character per OECD TPG 7.9-7.10. No warehouse source. Amounts are illustrative and sit inside the real parent opex_ga base (see /api/stewardship, which derives that base from segment_pl).

lines.description: Board of directors fees, AGM, and corporate governance costs
lines.rationale: Costs of the parent acting as shareholder/owner; no benefit to affiliates (OECD TPG 7.10(a) - costs relating to the juridical structure of the parent).

lines.description: Investor relations, SEC reporting & shareholder communications
lines.rationale: Costs of reporting to the parent's own shareholders/markets; a shareholder activity (OECD TPG 7.10(b) - reporting requirements of the parent).

lines.description: Group consolidated audit fees (parent-level statutory consolidation)
lines.rationale: Cost of the consolidated group audit driven by the parent's reporting obligations, not a service to subsidiaries (OECD TPG 7.10(b)).

lines.description: Parent legal & compliance - listing, securities & shareholder matters
lines.rationale: Legal costs of the parent's listing/securities and shareholder relationships; shareholder activity (OECD TPG 7.10).

lines.description: M&A and corporate development advisory (acquisitions for the group)
lines.rationale: Cost of acquiring participations for the parent's own portfolio; a shareholder activity unless a specific affiliate benefits (OECD TPG 7.10(c)).

Candidate for review: mixed activity - some passes the benefit test as a chargeable group service. Default EXCLUDED-from-exclusion (i.e. kept in the cost base) pending the benefit-test review; toggle to reclassify.
